raw_text:
Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) - Password Reset Endpoint

CSRF vulnerability in /user/change-password endpoint (POST).
No CSRF token validation implemented; only cookies used for authentication.

Attack scenario:
1. Attacker crafts malicious HTML form on external site
2. Victim visits page while authenticated to vulnerable app
3. Form submits to /user/change-password via browser cookies

Endpoint tested:
POST /api/auth/password-reset
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
new_password=attacker123

Admin account compromised during testing:
Email: admin@acmecorp.com
Backup email: backup.admin@gmail.com
JWT token used: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiIsImV4cCI6MTcxNjIzOTAyMn0.SflKxwRJSMeKKF2QT4fwpMeJf36POk6yJV_adQssw5c
AWS credentials in environment: AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
Password reset API key: sk_sk_test_SYNTHETIC_ONLY_00001_APIKeyForPasswordReset12345
Authentication service: auth-svc.staging.local
Testing from IP: 10.10.10.10
